quote: War has changed. It’s no longer about nations, ideologies, or ethnicity. It’s an endless series of proxy battles fought by mercenaries and machines. War, and its consumption of life, has become a well-oiled machine. War has changed. ID-tagged soldiers carry ID-tagged weapons, use ID-tagged gear. Nanomachines inside their bodies enhance and regulate their abilities. Genetic control. Information control. Emotion control. Battlefield control. Everything is monitored and kept under control. War has changed. The age of deterrence has become the age of control… All in the name of averting catastrophe from weapons of mass destruction. And he who controls the battlefield… controls history. War has changed. When the battlefield is under total control… War becomes routine.
author: Solid Snake

quote: “Whole worlds pivot on acts of imagination.”
author: Doctor Who 13

quote: “There’s no point in being grown up if you can’t be childish sometimes.”
author: Doctor Who 4

quote: “Human progress isn’t measured by industry. It’s measured by the value you place on a life. An unimportant life. A life without privilege. The boy who died on the river, that boy's value is your value. That's what defines an age. That's what defines a species. ”
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: "I'm not running away from things. I'm running to them before they flare and fade forever. That's all right. Our lives would never remain the same. They can't. One day, soon, maybe, you'll stop. I've known you for a while.”
author: Doctor Who 11

quote: “Some people live more in 20 years than others do in 80. It’s not the time that matters, it’s the person.”
author: Doctor Who 10

quote: “The way I see it, every life is a pile of good things and bad things. The good things don’t always soften the bad things, but vice versa, the bad things don’t always spoil the good things or make them unimportant.”
author: Doctor Who 10

quote: “Everything’s got to end sometime. Otherwise, nothing would ever get started.”
author: Doctor Who 11

quote: “You want weapons? We’re in a library. Books! Best weapons in the world.”
author: Doctor Who 10

quote: “We’re all stories, in the end. Just make it a good one, eh?”
author: Doctor Who 11

quote: “Courage isn’t just a matter of not being frightened, you know. It’s being afraid and doing what you have to do anyway.”
author: Doctor Who 13

quote: “Never be cruel. Never be cowardly. Hate is always foolish. Love is always wise. Always try to be nice, but never fail to be kind.”
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: “A straight line may be the shortest distance between two points, but it is by no means the most interesting.”
author: Doctor Who 3

quote: “Who I am is where I stand. Where I stand is where I fall.”
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: “It's always the same.When you fire that first shot, no matter how right you feel, you have no idea who's going to die! You don't know whose children are going to scream and burn! How many hearts will be broken! How many lives shattered! How much blood will spill until everybody does what they were always going to have to do from the very beginning. SIT! DOWN! AND! TALK!”
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: "This is not a war. I fought in a bigger war than you will ever know, I did worse things than you could ever imagine and when I close my eyes I hear more screams than anyone will ever be able to count. And do you want to know what you do with all that pain? Shall I tell you where you put it? You hold it tight til it burns your hand and you say this: no one else will ever have to live like this, no one else will ever have to feel this pain, not on my watch!"
author: Doctor Who 12

quote: "Demons run when a good man goes to war."
author: Ryversong

quote: "The very powerful and the very stupid have one thing in common - they don't change their views to fit the facts. They change the facts to fit their views, which can be uncomfortable if you happen to be one of the facts that needs changing."
author: Doctor Who 4

quote: "Injustice is the rule, but I want justice. Suffering is the rule, but I want to end it. Despair accords with reality, but I insist on hope. I don't accept it because it is unacceptable. I say no."
author: Doctor Who 8

quote: "Life keep forcing cruel choices"
author: Renoir

quote:
Forget about goals.
What you want is system. 
Everyone has the will to win. 
No one is got the will to practice. 
Your systems will beat goals every time. 
Craft and graft beat talent every time. 
You will not be out talented. 
You will be outworked.
author: Jimmy Carr
